resources.string: Version %1$s
Bug fixes
Added playlist support
Select multiple files at once when adding new tracks, or select the ‘%1$s’ option from a track’s options menu and select at least one additional track to create a playlist.
Added volume boost
Select the ‘%1$s’ option from a track or playlist’s options menu to boost the volume by up to 30dB without modifying the source file.
Exceed track limit
If the normal number of allowed tracks is exceeded, granting the app the read storage permission will allow any number of tracks to be added.
Fixed crash when exceeding the maximum number of allowed tracks.\nFixed the quick settings tile not updating its state.
Fixed (hopefully) a crash some users were experiencing when adding media.
Per-audio controls
Each audio item now has its own playback progress slider and playback speed setting from 0.1x to 5x.
Audio folders
Create folders from local audio or selected library items, add audio to folders, reorder folder contents with a long press, and play multiple folders together.
Language updates
Chinese wording now uses audio terminology more consistently.
Mistysound refresh
SoundAura is now Mistysound, with a new app name and icon.
Smoother folder opening
Folder pages now open immediately, and their audio lists appear progressively to reduce flashing during short loads.
Folder stability improvements
Fixed a crash that could occur when opening a folder before its contents finished loading.
Custom backgrounds
You can now manage separate main backgrounds and shared card backgrounds, import your own images, preview them, and save the one you want to apply.
Smarter page-based search
Search now follows the page you are on, so the library, folder view, and each background library all search their own content independently.
Background editing tools
Background images can be renamed, reordered, enabled or disabled, removed, and cropped with a dedicated editor before you save the effect.
Fixed a launch crash that could happen after updating from an older version, and fixed a crash when opening the custom background pages on a fresh install.
Frosted glass themes
Added dark and light frosted glass themes that give cards a translucent glass-style appearance across the library, settings, and background image pages.
Glass opacity control
When a frosted glass theme is selected, the display settings now show a 0-100% slider so you can fine-tune card opacity.
Backgrounds visible in more places
The top app bar is now transparent and the main background remains visible behind it and behind the settings page while still respecting the system status bar area.
Clearer background editing confirmation
The main background editor now shows a floating confirm button in the bottom-right corner, making it much clearer when your crop and zoom adjustments will be saved.
Frosted glass controls refined
Floating buttons, card overlays, sliders, and playback controls now follow the frosted glass theme more consistently with lighter and more transparent styling.
Smoother drag and pinch gestures
Improved the frosted glass opacity slider responsiveness, and made image dragging and pinch zooming in the background editor feel smoother and easier to control.
Separate release icons
The personal and public release builds now use their own launcher icons, making the two app packages easier to tell apart.
Softer frosted glass controls
Fine-tuned frosted glass control colors to feel lighter and more transparent while keeping the dark glass theme comfortable to look at.
More transparent active sliders
Reduced the visual weight of the active green slider layer and thumb so more of the background shows through on the home screen and in display settings.
Floating buttons refined
Adjusted floating action buttons and the bottom playback bar to better match the frosted glass theme with lighter, more see-through surfaces.
